next.reason: 1985 VII.4.6.3 SR3: 'Appearance of file-name-1 in a USE statement must not cause the simultaneous request for execution of more than one USE procedure.' With 1985 GR4 already excluding INPUT/OUTPUT/I-O/EXTEND USE for an explicitly named file, the rule refuses a file-name in two USE statements. §2023:14.9.49.3 SR8: 'The same file-name shall not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement within the same procedure division' (compile-time); §2023:14.9.49.4 GR5 gives the file-name USE precedence over the open-mode USE statements and §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3 executes only 'The first declarative that satisfies the selection criteria'. Same requirement.
